text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the autumn Tenno Sho,
and Gold
Ship unveils her secret weapon
in preparation for
this massive stage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The weapon? A pile of prickly sea
urchin-stuffed
chestnuts, spiky shells
and all! With these, all of
Голд Шип's
rivals will eat her dust! ☆
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I confiscate them all, of course, to
ensure a fair
race against Тосэн Джордан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
